reason: Nobody in my Telegram groups has mentioned CollegeStat, and I won't pay $99 to a site I can't verify when the deadlines and costs for Germany or Poland are mostly published free on the universities' own pages and discussed in the channels. I will try the free search and the one practice application and ask in the chats first.
objection: It doesn't guarantee admission, so what are we paying for? The refund covers a wrong deadline, but it does nothing if my child just doesn't get in. And Common App and UCAS are listed first, which are not even where we are aiming.
would_change_my_mind: Several parents in my Telegram groups saying their child used it for Germany or Korea and the shortlist and uni-assist practice were accurate, plus a lower price or paying in local currency without a foreign card.
